description: Global Dam Storage combines satellite reservoir area with bathymetric relationships to derive monthly storage for about 7,229 dams identified by GRanD IDs. The deposit documents a workbook, derivation code and environment configuration. This resource is provided by Okiria, Emmanuel. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists RTF, ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The storage series is derived, not observed; the summary does not state its full time span. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
